title: Lot Rounding on Gallons Credited to a Refined Fuels Pre-Buy Booking
content:
Gallons going to a member's credit on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts are rounded down to a lot before they are written, and whether the lot is the whole one or the half one turns on the size of the request and on whether a will-call stop has been billed recently.

**What a will-call stop is.** A will-call stop is one the records show the member called in, and not one run to the automatic keep-full schedule, run as an emergency, run after hours or made to fill against a booking.

**Where the gallons requested reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons and 1 or more will-call stops were billed on the account in the three months ending on the handling date**, the lot rule rounds the gallons down to the whole lot of 100 gallons.

**Where the gallons requested reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons and no will-call stop was billed in that window**, the lot rule rounds the gallons down to the half lot of 50 gallons.

**Where the gallons requested fall under the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons**, the lot rule leaves the gallons unrounded.

## The rule as conditions and results

| Gallons requested | Will-call stops billed in the three months ending on the handling date | The lot rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | 1 or more | Rounds down to the nearest whole 100 gallons |
| At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | None | Rounds down to the nearest whole 50 gallons |
| Below the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | Either way | Leaves the gallons unrounded |

Rounding down means the gallons are cut to the lot below, never carried up to the lot above.

*Hypothetical.* A figure of 2160.00 gallons on a request at or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons, on an account with a will-call stop billed in the quarter, is written as 2100 gallons. With no will-call stop billed in that quarter it is written as 2150 gallons. On a request below the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons it is written as 2160.00 gallons, exactly as it stood.
